assumptions.party: Fixed four, representative declared fixtures, not the user save; user constellation/save not provided. 4-star C0/C6 and 5-star C0 are explicit.
assumptions.repeat: 4 successive native same-level talent-domain battles with no inn, food, forced heal, HP/level/RNG reset, or enemy change; stop on defeat.
assumptions.gear: Same craft weapon, reinforced leather and healer brooch; enhancement3 at25 and6 at60, native phase and65%cap talents.
assumptions.time: Actual 2x presentation uses recorded frame ms/1000; +3sec per manual COMBAT and6sec receipt/reentry. No human/network/acquisition time claim.
assumptions.observation: Existing helper inserts only a nominal-heal observation callback before base heal clamping. r.action/damage/heal/finish wrappers record and call the native original. No heal or combat result is replaced.
assumptions.healing: Final nominal heal after constellation/talent/gear scaling, actual applied, cap loss, combat-end clipping and settlement level-up gain are distinct.
